item.title: Grand Theft Auto Relied on "Illusions" Over Simulation, According to Obbe Vermeij
item.description: The second part of GTA BOOM's interview with Obbe Vermeij where they turn from origin stories to craft. Specifically, how early GTA games created the illusion of life, and why that illusion still matters more than brute-force simulation.

item.title: Over the Top: WWI - World War I with permanent destruction
item.description: The new multiplayer action game Over the Top: WWI is set to be released in March. Up to 200 players will be able to battle each other on historical First World War battlefields. The developers gave Sector the opportunity to learn more about the game.

item.title: Reanimal Review | 4ScarrsGaming
item.description: Reanimal puts you in charge of siblings in a broken island chain, where light, stealth, and smart routes matter more than combat.

item.title: 11 indie gems to look forward to in 2026
item.description: Prepare for a bright year of witches, mice, yokai, and more.

item.title: Demon Tides Review The New Pinnacle Of Platforming - Pixel Byte
item.description: Demon Tides is a joyous sandbox to get lost in thanks to its freedom of movement. Welcome to the new pinnacle of platforming.

item.title: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 Review The Ultimate Road Trip from France to Japan |GLG
item.description: Gear.Club Unlimited 3 wastes no time throwing you into its globespanning world of asphalt, attitude, and automotive obsession. This indepth exploration of the series newest chapter takes you from the sunkissed French coast to the neonlit highways of Japan, blending highspeed racing with a surprising focus on car culture and clubbuilding. item.title: Turn-based strategy RPG Zanerdin: The Unbound announced for PS5, PC
item.description: South Korean game studio Sanctuary Games, a small team founded in April 2025 by former NEOWIZ business development manager Hyunduk You, has announced Zanerdin: The Unbound, a collectible turn-based strategy RPG featuring gacha gameplay without the microtransactions. It will be available for PlayStation 5 and PC via Steam. A release date was not announced.

item.title: WiZmans World Re;Try Review | The Outerhaven
item.description: WiZmans World Re;Try is a remaster of a game that never came to the west, WiZmans World. Find out the mysteries of the world at Wizarest.

item.description: Chatting with PUBG STUDIOS' Production Director, Seungmyeong Yang, we learn more about PUBG: BLINDSPOT and what Early Access means for the title.

item.title: Denshattack! Preview Sick Tricks | CGM
item.description: Denshattack! wants you to wrap your mind around its weird world and rules. But once you do, its quite literally going to take you on a ride.
